    "cd165416: ;Go to M^DIE17 if DV is defined, ^DIE3 if DV contains 'V', or P if DV doesn't contain 'S'. If there is code at ^DD(DP,DIFLD,12.1), execute it. Set % to the value between ';' and ':X' in DU. Set Y to X. If % is not null, execute DIC(\"S\") if defined. If no error, write '%' if DB(DQ) is undefined and go to V",

    "f2a8785e: ;Execute the code label 'X_DQ' and clear YS",
    "f877bd34: ;Clear DIC(\"S\") and DLAYGO. If X is defined and not null, set DG(DW) to X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,\"DIE\",DLB) to X and go to A",

    "376295e2: ;Set X to '?BAD'",
    "05dcbf67: ;Set DZ to X, call D, call QQ^DIEQ, and go to B",
    "a6f3c94c: ;Set up variable values for DIE call.",
    "b3a45790: ;If data exists, display it and allow editing if not Read-only.",
    "1ffc65d6: ;If data array exists, execute code to set DG and Y values.",
    "f4e79e0a: ;If pointer to file with LAYGO, get .01 value and set DG value.",
    "ef90097f: ;If DINUM subfile and value is coded, get external value.",
    "880bde01: ;If set of codes, get external value from : piece.",
    "43a1d0be: ;If no change, keep existing value, else validate new value.",
    "39a1b344: ;If not WP field, skip WP code.",
    "c6522356: ;Execute WP code.",
    "cfd4259b: ;No more code.",
    "43d3278b: ;Initialize variables for DIE call.",
